retrievalProfile.description: A Y2K-era electronic music aesthetic featuring a central figure against a chrome background, high-contrast orange accents, and technical audio-inspired typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition split horizontally, featuring a top section with a female subject in an orange dress against a curved chrome wall, and a bottom section of dark textured black. A large, glossy, oval-shaped graphic with lowercase techno lettering dominates the right side, while technical audio waveforms and high-fidelity icons anchor the lower half.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in orange dress mirrors the dominant orange graphic element on the right.
Curved chrome background panels create a sense of futuristic interior space.
Horizontal division separates the photographic upper half from the typographic lower half.
Audio waveform graphic acts as a visual bridge between the title text and the right margin.
coreInvariants: High-gloss orange and silver color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Female subject positioned left-of-center, full-body shot at medium scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: Large glossy orange and black oval logo on the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject to the large logo, then down to the title text and across the waveform.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black textured space in the bottom third provides a base for technical metadata.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and textured charcoal in the lower section.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant safety orange used for the dress and graphic overlays.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the orange elements against a desaturated, high-contrast background.

letterConstructionRules: Lowercase letters in the logo are thick, rounded, and interconnected.
Title text uses wide-tracked, all-caps geometric sans-serif.
Secondary text uses condensed, high-contrast serif with decorative spurs.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'm' and 'g' are stylized with thick strokes and integrated into an oval frame.
The colon in the logo is used as a central divider.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-bold rounded techno-logos and clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric, tech-inspired feel of the title.
Captures the Y2K futuristic aesthetic perfectly.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split-screen image. Top half: a woman in a bright orange dress standing in a futuristic room with curved chrome/silver paneled walls. Bottom half: a dark, gritty black textured surface. Add a large orange gradient oval on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide-tracked white sans-serif text across the middle. Place a stylized lowercase logo inside the orange oval. Add a white audio waveform to the right of the title and technical badges in the bottom corners.

verificationChecks: Is the orange vibrant and high-contrast?
Does the chrome background have a realistic metallic sheen?
Is the title text widely spaced?
Is the waveform graphic sharp and technical?

adjustableVariables: Color of the dress and logo (e.g., neon green instead of orange)
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic reflection accuracy on the chrome walls.
Ensure the orange elements are consistent in hue.
Verify the text is legible against the dark background.
Confirm the waveform graphic does not overlap the subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a futuristic metallic interior with a high-saturation pop color accent and technical audio-visual typography for a Y2K electronic aesthetic.
